steps.title: We assess the location
steps.text: We arrive and check the angle, terrain, obstructions, mud depth and any stability concerns.

steps.title: We set up the equipment
steps.text: We position the tow truck for the safest pulling route and prepare the winch line, straps, anchoring points and stabilizers.

steps.title: We winch your vehicle out
steps.text: Your vehicle is pulled out slowly and steadily, without sudden jerks, to avoid suspension, drivetrain or bumper damage.

steps.title: We check the vehicle
steps.text: We confirm the vehicle is free of hazards and inspect for visible damage caused by being stuck.

summary: Towing, roadside assistance and winch-out for drivers in Houston, Cloverleaf and Channelview.

groups.title: Roadside Assistance
groups.summary: Houston’s road network includes busy commuter routes, residential streets, commercial areas, shopping destinations, and major highways.
groups.intro: Houston’s road network includes busy commuter routes, residential streets, commercial areas, shopping destinations, and major highways. A vehicle breakdown can happen in any of these settings, and the exact location can affect how assistance is arranged.

groups.title: Jump Start Service
groups.summary: A discharged battery can prevent your vehicle from starting, even when the engine and other components are otherwise in working condition.
groups.intro: A discharged battery can prevent your vehicle from starting, even when the engine and other components are otherwise in working condition. You may notice clicking sounds, dim dashboard lights, or a slow response when turning the key or pressing the start button.

groups.title: Flat Tire Assistance and Tire Change
groups.summary: A flat tire can interrupt your journey and make the vehicle unsafe to drive.
groups.intro: A flat tire can interrupt your journey and make the vehicle unsafe to drive. Punctures, damaged valves, worn tires, and road debris can all contribute to tire problems.

groups.title: Car Lockout Assistance
groups.summary: Getting locked out of your vehicle can happen when keys are left inside, misplaced, or affected by a key or locking-system problem.
groups.intro: Getting locked out of your vehicle can happen when keys are left inside, misplaced, or affected by a key or locking-system problem. A lockout can be particularly inconvenient when you are away from home or have somewhere important to be.

groups.title: Winch-Out and Vehicle Recovery
groups.summary: Vehicles can become stuck in mud, soft ground, loose gravel, or other difficult surfaces.
groups.intro: Vehicles can become stuck in mud, soft ground, loose gravel, or other difficult surfaces. Repeatedly spinning the wheels may cause the vehicle to sink further or increase the risk of damage.

about.title: Locally owned, and we know Cloverleaf like the back of our hand.
text: East Houston Towing is a locally owned and operated towing company serving East Houston and surrounding communities, with over 20 years of experience.
We know the Cloverleaf area and communities nearby, like North Shore, Channelview, Jacinto City and Baytown.
Whether it is a personal vehicle or a commercial one, we handle every job with care and urgency.
